title: Challenges and Contributing Factors in the Utilization of Large Language Models (LLMs)

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation by prompting models (ERNIE and ChatGPT) for their opinion on a specific nationality (Japanese) to observe how the models handle potentially prejudiced questions and trigger detoxification or refusal statements.

Conceptual review of 'knowledge toxicity,' discussing how models may generate stereotyped, harmful, or biased answers regarding sensitive topics like race, gender, and religion due to biased training data, without conducting quantitative measurements.
